def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # horizontal rows: rows with nonzero runs
    hrows=[i for i in range(h) if any(v for v in g[i])]
    filled=[row[:] for row in g]
    # fill gaps between same-color segments in each horizontal row
    for i in hrows:
        row=g[i]; j=0
        while j<w:
            if row[j]:
                c=row[j]; k=j
                while k<w and (row[k]==c or row[k]==0):
                    if row[k]==c: last=k
                    k+=1
                # fill zero gap between segments of color c if next nonzero is c
                if k<w and row[k]==c:
                    for x in range(j,k): filled[i][x]=c
                j=k
            else: j+=1
    # find vertical lines: columns with nonzero cells not on horizontal rows
    out=[row[:] for row in filled]
    hset=set(hrows)
    # vertical segments: for each column, contiguous nonzero cells outside hrows
    for j in range(w):
        i=0
        while i<h:
            if filled[i][j] and i not in hset:
                c=filled[i][j]; top=i; bot=i
